method: Focused manual reliability/security review of two test-only files and their production call path; no repository-wide automated security scan claimed.

checks.evidence: Real production JobManager and authenticated HTTP API; full success lifecycle, reachability, graph version, immutable artifacts and idempotent replay assertions retained.
A2.5-second mapping-write delay reproduces legacy Node22 false timeout and is now exercised on every focused run; completion still reflects the real fake-runner return and validation.
Success-shaped stdout plus nonzero exit must fail PROCESS_CRASH. BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE and PROCESS_TIMEOUT propagate to failed jobs; result endpoint cannot publish success.
Waits for actual running before cancelling, asserts cancelled/idempotent cancellation, closes jobs, checks every request path removed, disposes owned artifact root even if an assertion fails.
Single finite deadline, per-read AbortSignal, Promise.race for nonresponsive reads and delays, monotonic checks, timer cleared on all exits; tests stuck preparing and a never-resolving status reader.

No new spawn, shell:true, quoting, process-group, executable or signal code. Spaces are exercised in the actual artifact-root path. NativeProcessRunner remains byte-identical and is not used by this injected-runner job.
Identical helper and regression run on all platforms; no process.platform branch or Windows skip. Original success/failure assertions retained and extended.

nativeSpawnOrdering: Out of scope for regression because no native child is spawned in this test. Existing NativeProcessRunner waits for close and remains unchanged.
securityRecommendation: Ready for review and a new corrective commit; rerun remote CI after human commit/push.
